integrity: Only the stated theorem has been analytically proved here; no experimental or independent verification is claimed. An analogous claim in inaccessible primary or more general exponential-mixture literature may subsume it.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-input, linear first-order depot absorption and elimination only; differentiable between activation events, with strict local modes rather than experimentally resolvable peaks. The result is not a dosing recommendation.
title: A sharp reentrant two-peak window for delayed unequal Bateman inputs
